contexts.text: Falsities with the spiritual man... are like the dense spots of a cloud.
Can the leopard change his spots? (). Explained. ( = truths falsified. AE 780:5.)
Thus spotted = truth with which falsity is mixed. Explained. AC 3993:7. AC 4000. AC 4005. AC 4006. AC 4020.
Hence spotted, in the Hebrew, is expressed by a word which also means lambs. Illustrated.

As spots = falsities, it was forbidden that anyone of the seed of Aaron in whom there was a blemish, should approach the altar (). And also that no sacrifice of (animals) in which there was a blemish should be made (); where the blemishes are enumerated. AE 867:4.
The Word, with such, is as if spotted with blots.
They see the watery parts (of the planet) as spots.
Called a white spot upon the cornea.
A black spot seen under the left eye, which they said meant that they were to desist from speaking.
One sees another as... shining spots...
That the things being written would appear hypothetical, with blemishes.
If spots appear upon their garments, they know (that they have thought something evil). SE 5664.
The garments of those who are in falsities appear (there) spotted.
